prompt: 포켓몬 카드 리셀 시장 조사해서 보고서로 만들어줘
assertions: output_is_valid_docx: A .docx file was produced and opens without error via python-docx
has_title_page_metadata: Document contains 작성일/작성자/문서구분 (or clear English equivalents) metadata lines near the top
has_toc: Document contains a 목차 (table of contents) section listing the main section titles
has_numbered_sections: Document contains at least 5 numbered top-level sections (e.g. '1. ...' through '7./8. ...')
has_subsections: At least one section has numbered subsections (e.g. '4.1', '4.2')
has_references_section: Document contains a 참고 자료(출처) or equivalent references section with at least 3 entries
references_are_hyperlinks: At least some reference URLs are real, working-looking hyperlinks (not just plain text guesses)
title_font_size_30pt: The main title run uses 30pt font size (40px per the skill's px->pt convention)
body_font_size_15pt: Body paragraph runs use 15pt font size (20px per the skill's convention)
font_is_malgun_gothic: Text runs specify 맑은 고딕 (Malgun Gothic) as the font, including the eastAsia font tag
main_color_applied: Title/section headings use a non-default (non-black) main color consistently
content_is_researched_not_fabricated: Facts/statistics in the body are plausible and traceable to real sources cited in references, not generic placeholder claims
